description: This file defines classes and functions related to Python value handling within the Torch JIT compiler, including SugaredValue subclasses for Python objects, modules, CUDA modules, and other Python constructs, as well as utility functions for converting Python objects to SugaredValues.

classes.name: PythonValue
classes.description: Represents a Python object as a SugaredValue, allowing it to be used within TorchScript, with methods for calling, attribute access, and tuple conversion.

classes.name: PythonModuleValue
classes.description: Represents a Python module object as a SugaredValue, allowing attribute access within TorchScript.

classes.name: CUDAPythonModuleValue
classes.description: Specialized SugaredValue for desugaring torch.cuda modules.

classes.name: ConstantParameterList
classes.description: Represents a list of module parameters as a SugaredValue.

classes.name: ModuleDictMethod
classes.description: Represents a method for module dictionaries within TorchScript.

classes.name: SugaredDict
classes.description: Represents a dictionary of modules or parameters, supporting iteration and attribute access.

classes.name: ModuleValue
classes.description: Represents a module object in TorchScript, supporting attribute access, method calls, and submodule management.

classes.name: PythonClassValue
classes.description: Represents a Python class as a SugaredValue.

classes.name: PythonExceptionValue
classes.description: Represents a Python exception as a SugaredValue.

classes.name: PythonSliceClass
classes.description: Represents the Python slice class as a SugaredValue.

methods.name: toSimple
methods.description: Converts a Value* to a SugaredValue by wrapping it in a SimpleValue.

methods.name: toSugaredValue
methods.description: Converts a Python object to a SugaredValue within a given graph context.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the function schema for a PythonValue.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls the PythonValue or its subclasses as a function.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Accesses an attribute of the PythonValue or its subclasses.

methods.name: getattr
methods.description: Helper to get an attribute from a Python object.

methods.name: checkForAddToConstantsError
methods.description: Checks for errors when adding to constants.

methods.name: asValue
methods.description: Converts a PythonValue to a Value* in the Torch JIT.

methods.name: tryGetAttr
methods.description: Attempts to get an attribute from a ModuleValue.

methods.name: hasAttr
methods.description: Checks if a ModuleValue has a specific attribute.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Sets an attribute on a ModuleValue.

methods.name: iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over a ModuleValue.

methods.name: getitem
methods.description: Gets an item from a ModuleValue.

methods.name: areAllSubmodulesSubtypeOf
methods.description: Checks if all submodules are of a certain subtype.

methods.name: isNamedTupleClass
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a NamedTuple class.

methods.name: registerNamedTuple
methods.description: Registers a NamedTuple class for TorchScript.

methods.name: recurseThroughNestedModules
methods.description: Recursively processes nested modules for TorchScript.
